name: SysEx Test
author: Schwung
description: Sends and validates large SysEx over cable 2. Pads pick a payload size; the tool packetizes, sends in one burst, and reports how many packets the host refused. Inbound SysEx is reassembled and checked byte-for-byte against the same generator, so a run of lost packets shows as a byte count and a first-bad-offset rather than as silence.
